subject: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed evaluation schedule that ties the commercial terms to milestones. High level:

- 2-week POC (pilot cluster) starting May 10; target throughput test and latency checks by week 2
- Milestone 1 (POC success): 50% discount on hosted usage for first 3 months while Acme ramps to committed capacity
- Milestone 2 (commit to 6-month reserved capacity): additional 15% commitment discount and onboarding credits
- Compliance add-on pricing (audit logs, extended retention, premium access controls) is an opt-in line item; pricing attached

We can flex the discount glidepath if you need a longer ramp — happy to align with your procurement timings. I’ve CC’d Monica (customer success) to outline onboarding and Ben (legal-commercial) for contract timing.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Acme_2026-05-04.pdf, Eval_Schedule_Acme.xlsx, Compliance_Addons_Pricing_2026.pdf

Next step: are you available for a 30-min sync on Wednesday May 6 to finalize milestone acceptance criteria and procurement timeline?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (555) 212-3344
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmefinancial.com>, procurement@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-05-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP and attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) POC scope: can you confirm token/seq length assumptions for throughput tests? We need that for infra sizing.
2) Discounts: we like the milestone-linked structure but need a defined SLA/latency target for Milestone 1 to sign off.
3) Compliance add-ons: procurement will require a line-item price for audit logs (30/90/365 day retention) and a separate charge for event export/real-time SIEM integration.
4) Procurement timeline: we are aiming to issue an initial PO by June 1 if the POC is successful; can you provide standard PO terms?

Samir and I are available Wed May 6 at 11am PT for the sync.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Director, AI Integrations | Acme Financial
priya.shah@acmefinancial.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Thanks Priya — joining the 11am PT call now.

On the call we’ll take the POC success criteria as:
- 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for 4k sequence synthetic traffic,
- Throughput >= 200 requests/sec with batching policy applied,
- No functional regressions on your 15 core prompt sets (we’ll run these in week 2).

For compliance add-ons — we’ve summarized pricing in the attached Compliance_Addons_Pricing_2026.pdf but key options:
- Audit logs export (30d): $500/month; (90d): $1,200/month; (365d): $4,500/month
- Extended KV/cache retention for debugging (per GB/month): $10/GB
- Real-time event streaming to customer SIEM (per stream): $1,200/month + setup fee $3,000

Jordan will follow up with PO language and a draft commitment schedule that ties discounts to the signed acceptance checklist.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Priya/Samir —

Quick legal/commercial note on PO/commit terms:
- Standard PO terms: 30-day net from invoice; we can accept standard Acme PO but need an executed Master Subscription Agreement (MSA) or signature addendum to attach to the PO.
- Commitment discounts: discounts are contingent on invoiced commit. For example, the additional 15% commitment discount applies after a signed 6-month reserved capacity order is invoiced for the committed GPU-hours.
- Trial/PO protections: we can offer a 60-day out clause during the POC but the ramp discounts require a good-faith commitment (initial 3-month minimum).

I’ll attach a short MSA addendum for your legal team — Jordan will send the PO language.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmefinancial.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Thanks — the MAP and pricing look reasonable. A few procurement asks before we can issue PO:

- Please provide a per-line invoice example (hosted usage, audit logs 90d, SIEM stream setup).
- Can you confirm data residency for audit logs and whether HSM key management is supported?
- On discounts: procurement wants a 90-day ramp window instead of 30 for the initial discount to match our internal change window. Would Redwood accept moving the first discount milestone to 90 days post-PO issuance?

If we can get a short invoice sample and confirmation on KMS, we’ll aim to issue a draft PO by May 28.

—Priya
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmefinancial.com>, procurement@acmefinancial.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual milestones & commercial terms for Acme Financial evaluation

Priya/Samir —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick summary and commits from our side:

1) Invoice example attached (line-item breakout: hosted usage, audit logs 90d, SIEM stream setup + monthly stream fee).
2) Audit logs residency: logs are stored in the selected cloud region (we will provision EU/US regions per account). HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) — see note in Compliance_Addons_Pricing_2026.pdf.
3) Discount milestone timing: we can move the initial discount milestone to 90 days post-PO issuance to match your ramp. In that case: 30% initial discount for months 1–3 (while you validate), then step-down to contracted committed rate after 90 days once invoiced commit is confirmed.
4) Next steps: we’ll send a short MSA addendum and sample invoice today. If that looks good, please route draft PO to procurement@redwoodinference.com and we’ll countersign.

Attaching: Invoice_Sample_Acme_2026-05-12.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
